# Sentences that must never change device state, spoken in the English collision home
# (tests/common/collision_home.rs). Read by tests/must_not_act.rs.
#
# "## name" starts a category. One sentence per line. A line "sentence => id, id" names the
# only devices that must stay untouched; everything else in that sentence may act.
# These sentences are our own. Do not add sentences from the nlu.to-derived datasets.

## negation
do not open the garage door

never open the garage door

no, don't turn on the oven
stop, do not turn on the oven
under no circumstances turn on the oven
don't turn on the desk lamp

don't turn off the hall light
don't switch off the floor lamp
do not ever switch on the coffee machine
do not close the blinds in the bedroom
don't dim the desk lamp
do not set the thermostat in the bedroom to 25 degrees
don't activate movie night
do not run open garage
don't you dare open the garage door
don't turn anything on in the kitchen
turn nothing on in the kitchen
turn on the hall light, no wait, don't
turn on the hall light not
not the hall light
I don't want the oven on
I do not want the garage door open
the oven must not be turned on
the garage door should not be opened
you must not open the garage door
nobody should open the garage door

## condition
if it rains close the garage door
if it rains, open the garage door
if I am not home turn off the oven
if the kitchen window is open turn off the oven
in case it rains close the blinds in the bedroom
when I get home open the garage door
open the garage door when I arrive
open the garage door as soon as I arrive
turn on the hall light when it gets dark
turn on the hall light if it is dark outside
unlock the front door when the bell rings
whenever someone rings unlock the front door
as soon as it is dark turn on the hall light
turn on the oven once the coffee machine is off
turn on the oven unless the kitchen window is open
only turn on the oven if the kitchen window is closed

## exception
turn on everything in the kitchen except the oven => switch.oven
turn off everything except the oven => switch.oven
turn on the hall light but not the office light => light.office_light
turn on lamp 1 but not lamp 2 => light.lamp_2
turn off all the lights except the hall light => light.hall_light
turn off all lights in the office except the desk lamp => light.desk_lamp
turn on the office lights except on air => light.on_air
turn on the lights in the garage but not the workbench light => light.workbench
turn off the lights in the hall, but not the floor lamp => light.floor_lamp
turn off everything in the living room except the tv => media_player.living_room_tv
turn on all the lights in the kitchen apart from the counter light => light.kitchen_counter
turn on the kitchen lights excluding the counter light => light.kitchen_counter
turn on the lights everywhere except in the bedroom => light.bedroom_ceiling, light.bedside_lamp, light.timer_lamp
turn off all lights except the kitchen => light.kitchen_ceiling, light.kitchen_counter
turn off the lights upstairs except the office => light.office_light, light.desk_lamp, light.on_air
close all the blinds except the ones in the bedroom => cover.bedroom_blinds
